notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Treebeard triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Foods, you may sacrifice them to Peregrin Took to draw infinite cards.
